feeding_claim.verbatim: Visit our retail store to purchase grass-fed and grain-finished beef, from soup bones to filet mignon.

notes: Retail brand of Perdido River Farms, a Tribal agricultural operation in Atmore (cow/calf herd of 700+ cows, rotational grazing). Beef is sold only at the operation's own retail store at 490 Atmosphere Rd, not at the farm, recorded as on-farm-store. Store hours Mon to Fri 8 to 5:30, Sat 8 to 2. Pork is also sold as packaged cuts but the site does not say it is raised on the farm, so pork left out of species. Beef bundles sold; cut sheet offered for whole and half beef; custom cutting at 251-368-9136 ext. 2447. Also sells wholesale to restaurants and stores. No delivery or shipping.
